# Export

Guide for **Export** APIs in Giddh.

## Authentication

Send `Auth-Key` or `Session-Id`. Base URL: `https://api.giddh.com`.

## Open in API Reference

Full request/response schemas: [Export](/p/export?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Endpoints in this module (4)

- [Get All Export Settings](/p/get-all-export-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Update Export Settings](/p/update-export-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Bulk Export](/p/bulk-export?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Export Vouchers With Export Settings](/p/export-vouchers-with-export-settings?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Notes

- Prefer endpoint pages for exact query params, body fields, and examples.
- For voucher / business-document flows, pass `voucherVersion=2` when the endpoint documents it.
